import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer


def main():
    X = np.genfromtxt("data.csv", delimiter=",", dtype=None)
    y = np.random.choice(2, size=10)

    # Split data first
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=2)

    # Impute on training split only
    imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy="median")
    X_train_imputed = imputer.fit_transform(X_train)
    X_test_imputed = imputer.transform(X_test)

    # Scale on training split only
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    A_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_imputed)
    A_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test_imputed)

    first = LogisticRegression()
    first.fit(X_train_imputed, y_train)
    print("first:", first.score(X_test_imputed, y_test))

    second = LogisticRegression()
    second.fit(A_train_scaled, y_train)  # Use y_train instead of b_train
    print("second:", second.score(A_test_scaled, y_test))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
